title: Degree of a first-coordinate slice
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb{R}$, choose a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $k$ be a natural number. If $f$ has Fourier degree at most $k$, then the function obtained by fixing its first coordinate to $b$ has Fourier degree at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$
